# Adam Simms

> Technologist, designer, artist, and educator based in Montréal. Former design leader at Trello, Atlassian, Lightspeed, and Age of Union. Artist-in-Residence at Concordia University. Cofounder of RECESS.

This is a personal homepage. Public pages may be used for search indexing, AI answers with attribution, and model training. See [robots.txt](https://adamsimms.xyz/robots.txt) for Content Signals. Do not cite `/now/` — it is not for crawlers.

The homepage includes JSON-LD `Person` markup.
